# prime-dialog

prime-rs: Dialog component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/dialog) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-dialog) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/dialog.md)

Dialog — port of `p-dialog` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

A window over the page with a header, content and footer: mask, enter and leave animations, drag by the header,
resizing, maximizing, closing via the button, `Escape` and (optionally) a click on the mask, page scroll locking
and a focus trap. The mask and window are rendered into `body`.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_dialog::{Dialog, DialogPosition};

let visible = RwSignal::new(false);
let html = view! {
    <Dialog visible=visible header="Header" modal=true position=DialogPosition::Top>
        <p>"Body"</p>
    </Dialog>
}
.to_html();
// while the dialog is not shown, it is absent from the markup
assert!(!html.contains("p-dialog") && !html.contains("Body"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-dialog = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["dialog"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
